title: I finally built the text adventure I've wanted to play since the 90s
author: Senzu
selftext:
I've been hooked on AI roleplay since AI Dungeon in 2019 and I've spent a lot of time in the deep end of setup: cards, presets, regex, lorebooks, picking models, wiring up keys. I love that depth. But every time I tried to bring a friend in, the spark died somewhere around "okay first you need an API key."

So I built Slypen (slypen.ai) to see how far I could collapse that onboarding.

You write a few sentences about a world or scenario, and you're playing. That's the whole flow. There's no API key and no backend to wire up, since you get Claude running on my dime right out of the box. Basically I wanted the depth without the three hours of tuning: keep what makes this great, cut the friction that scares newcomers off.

It's been tested up to 300+ turns with no memory loss, and no context bloat (good for me :D).

It's free to try, and I'd really appreciate any feedback! I'm always looking at the discord.

slypen.ai

Discord: https://discord.gg/4qzedJcAJ

replies.author: Senzu
replies.body:
<3 I'm so glad you like it! 

Any feedback is truly welcome!

comments.author: Plaisanterie
comments.body: I’m currently trying it right now and I’m shocked at how amazing it is - the characters feel accurate, maybe even too accurate, this is completely another level compared to some other websites with chat bots. I can actually roleplay to my heart’s content~!

replies.author: Senzu
replies.body:
Hell yeah, thank you!

So glad you like it so far!

comments.author: Certain-Tell8871
comments.body: Is there A chance that you can make a paid tier with Unlimited Messaging Instead of using Tokens??? That’d be awesome!!!!

replies.author: Senzu
replies.body:
I'm not sure that's possible right now :(. I just ran an analysis and it can easily cost me over $2,000 a month (per user).

The best I could do is a $149 a month sub that gives 60 turns per day.

replies.author: Certain-Tell8871
replies.body: I truly Enjoy the way the ai just sets up the world for me, I’ve tried finding many alternatives for that but there is none like yours.

replies.author: Senzu
replies.body:
Aww thank you so much :D. It really warms my heart to hear that <3

Feel free to join [the discord](https://discord.gg/qE8ckgeJh) if you have any desire! I post daily updates and respond to as many messages as I can!

comments.author: ValuableDapper9415
comments.body:
I had fun trying your game, I like it but it feel too verbose, almost like a book, but we are on a 16:9 screen and it feel hard to read all the text. But very funny ! I tried a sci-fi medieval theme to see if your workflows could support this weird fusion and it seems to nail it.

  
Big up for you to let people try without any account.

Thanks mate

https://preview.redd.it/e2oeqhjhuqgh1.png?width=947&format=png&auto=webp&s=ebbcfd4a73b2d07d02d35470e959bc358a013628

replies.author: Senzu
replies.body:
Thank you so much for trying it! And hell yeah, I love seeing people try weird scenarios. I had one user tell me that they did 100's of turns as a sentient chair LOL.

And yeah, it is intentionally book-like. The cost of the model I'm using makes short turns burn money like crazy. But I'll take that criticizism into account!

replies.author: ValuableDapper9415
replies.body:
Holy cow, a damn chair 😂😂😂

I’m not dislexic but I like to use dislexic fonts, they tend to be better readable for big chunks of text, so 0 rework from your end except adding a new font if you are willing to, a nice quick win.

Another quick win would maybe to add a different color variation for the background of each paragraph, or the mouse over a paragraph highlight it

replies.author: Senzu
replies.body: I should have mentioned this before but if you go into the top right drop down menu you can see a bunch of options under the "Display" dropdown. I can definitely add a dyslexic friendly font! Do you have a favorite?
